title: Change Proposal
description: Validates the content of a change-proposal artifact. A forge-neutral envelope for submitted changes with an immutable review-round version and connector-issued capability handle.

work_unit.description: Common envelope - threads to work unit.

branch.description: Feature branch name carrying the proposed change.

commit.description: Head commit SHA or stable commit identifier at proposal time.

base.description: Base branch or revision the proposal targets.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of the proposed change.

handle.description: Connector-issued forge capability handle for where reviewers inspect this version.

id.description: Connector-issued identity token; compared for equality only by the engine. Must be a complete, scoped work-unit identity per FORGE-CAPABILITY.md (Forge Work-Unit Identity); the prose is authoritative.

display.description: Human-readable rendering of the handled object.
